evals.query: Create App Store screenshots for my Arabic fund-investment app. The real app screenshots and the headline copy per screen are in snduk-designs/input/. Target iPhone 6.9" (1320x2868). Deliver PNGs.
expected_behavior: Confirms input screenshots exist and uses ONLY user-provided screenshots as product UI (never invents app content)
States or asks about frame choice before building (iPhone vs others); if unattended, records the assumption
Creates the skill's directory layout (input/, output/<frame>/, scripts/, templates/demo|screens)
Writes one thin HTML template per screen plus a single shared stylesheet with theme custom properties
Runs the skill's scripts/capture.py with a JSON shot list instead of hand-writing Playwright code
Output PNGs are exactly 1320x2868 and each is opened and visually QA'd; defects fixed in templates and recaptured
Final report lists delivered file paths and any known issues

evals.query: I need Google Play assets from the screenshots in snduk-designs/input/: phone screenshots at 1080x1920 plus a 1024x500 feature graphic.
expected_behavior: Consults references/frames.md for Play aspect-ratio rules and feature graphic size
Phone shots captured at exactly 1080x1920; feature graphic at exactly 1024x500 with a landscape composition (device frame not cropped by portrait canvas)
Reuses the same templates with different canvas/viewport rather than duplicating designs
QA pass on every PNG before delivery

evals.query: Make my app look good on the store.
expected_behavior: Does NOT start building graphics immediately
Asks for input screenshots (mandatory), which device frames to support, target stores, and brand/copy
Does not fabricate product UI from the app description alone
